stories.title: Report counts 81 US aircraft and drones lost or damaged in Iran war
stories.summary: A Congressional Research Service report prepared for lawmakers says at least 81 US military aircraft and drones have been damaged or destroyed since the war with Iran began on Feb. 28, including 45 MQ-9 Reapers and 12 F-15E Strike Eagles. The tally adds detail to a conflict whose Pentagon price tag has reached 43.6 billion dollars.

stories.title: Russia pounds Ukrainian cities, killing at least 24
stories.summary: Russian missiles and drones hit Kyiv and other regions overnight in what officials called a massive strike, killing at least 24 civilians including four children and wounding around 60. Ukrainian officials said the attack was anticipated as Moscow escalates its long-range campaign.

stories.title: Rubio says Iran has lost complete control of the Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said from Athens that oil is flowing through the Strait of Hormuz at nearly prewar levels and that Iran has lost complete control of the waterway, with its economy in freefall under sanctions. IRGC advisers disputed the claim, insisting the strait remains closed to unauthorized traffic.

stories.title: Vance softens US demand on Iranian uranium enrichment
stories.summary: In a Reuters interview, Vice President JD Vance said Tehran must make a meaningful reduction in enrichment capacity to end the war, rather than give up enrichment entirely as the White House had demanded before the conflict began. A senior Iranian official replied that the right to enrich is a red line.

stories.title: Tony Fadell explains why the first wave of AI gadgets failed
stories.summary: The Nest co-founder said early AI hardware stumbled by chasing novelty instead of solving a concrete problem for users. He argued the next wave will win by fitting into devices and workflows people already use rather than replacing them.

stories.title: Google opens SynthID site to check whether media is AI-generated
stories.summary: Google launched a public website that lets anyone upload an image, video or audio clip to test for its SynthID watermark. The tool is aimed at giving readers and publishers a simple way to check whether content was generated by AI.

stories.title: Google Labs launches Playground, an AI game-creation platform
stories.summary: Google Labs opened Playground, a browser tool that builds playable games from simple text prompts, with Unity Spark integration promised in a later update. The launch pushes Google into a fast-growing market of AI-assisted game development alongside Roblox and others.

stories.title: Microsoft unveils an AI coding model that runs on the PC
stories.summary: At a San Francisco event Microsoft announced an AI coding model designed to run directly on personal computers, plus new security technology meant to stop AI-driven attacks. Reuters reported the AI push as Microsoft moves to challenge Apple on hardware.

stories.title: Browns defensive tackles Graham and Hall miss practice before Jets
stories.summary: Mason Graham (knee) and Mike Hall Jr. (ankle) sat out Wednesday as Cleveland opened preparations for the New York Jets, while center Elgton Jenkins cleared concussion protocol. Coach Todd Monken said Graham is week to week and may miss a game or two rather than go on injured reserve.

stories.title: Browns back on the practice field with the Jets next
stories.summary: The 3-1 Browns returned to work in Berea on Wednesday, five days after beating Pittsburgh, with a road trip to the 1-3 Jets on Sunday. Reporters tracked roster moves, injury updates and Deshaun Watson progress through the day.

stories.title: How the Browns defense got back to man coverage and back to winning
stories.summary: After a Week 1 blowout, coordinator Mike Rutenberg leaned into man coverage, and Cleveland has used it on an NFL-high 50 percent of opponent dropbacks, including 73 percent against the Steelers. The unit is a big reason the Browns sit 3-1 despite losing Myles Garrett in the offseason.

stories.title: Browns sign WR James Proche and DT Chris Williams to practice squad
stories.summary: Cleveland added receiver and returner James Proche and defensive tackle Chris Williams to the practice squad, releasing running back Eric Gray, punter Wes Pahl and tackle Xavier Truss. The moves add return experience and interior depth before the Jets game.

stories.title: Ohio State recruiting storylines for October
stories.summary: On3 outlined the recruitments to watch this month, noting the Buckeyes will be on national television repeatedly while playing mostly away from Ohio Stadium. The staff is using those road trips to press its 2027 class, currently ranked in the top five nationally.

stories.title: Ryan Day challenges cornerback Devin Sanchez before Maryland
stories.summary: After two pass-interference calls at Iowa, Day said Sanchez must show more composure at the top of routes while keeping his aggression. Maryland offers an immediate test with a passing game that will target the sophomore corner.

stories.title: Week 6 preview: Ohio State hosts Maryland
stories.summary: No. 5 Ohio State plays Maryland on Saturday with Jeremiah Smith chasing Big Ten receiving records and the run game still hunting explosive plays. The Terrapins come off a bye and were run over in Big Ten play by Nebraska and UCLA.
stories.source: Yahoo Sports | Last Word on Sports

stories.title: Wolff confirms Russell will start from the back in Singapore
stories.summary: Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff confirmed George Russell takes a power unit penalty and will start Sunday from the back after his Malaysia engine failure, calling it particularly frustrating. Russell trails teammate Kimi Antonelli by 84 points with seven races left.

stories.title: Drivers react to the FIA software glitch that disrupted Malaysia
stories.summary: A bug in the FIA shared power unit software stalled cars on a wet formation lap at Sepang and forced a red flag before the race could start. Max Verstappen compared the experience to a Lego race, while Fernando Alonso said F1 leans on too much technology.

stories.title: Mercedes confirm Russell grid penalty for Singapore
stories.summary: Formula 1 reported that Russell exceeds his season power unit allocation after the Malaysia failure, triggering a penalty of at least 10 places that Mercedes expects to mean a start from the back. The penalty applies to Sunday race only, leaving Saturday Sprint points in play.

stories.title: Columbus man sentenced to 25 to 30.5 years in fatal bus stop shooting
stories.summary: Joshua Bays, 46, pleaded guilty to involuntary manslaughter and tampering with evidence in the August 2025 killing of Thomas Smith at a West Broad Street bus stop, plus escape in a separate case. He fled on a bicycle and was identified after his wife gave detectives his description.

stories.title: Police identify man killed in west Columbus shooting
stories.summary: Columbus police said Cedric Cole, 53, was found with a gunshot wound on Clarendon Lane just before 8 p.m. Tuesday and died at a hospital about 30 minutes later. Detectives are looking for several people seen in the area and have not announced a motive.

stories.title: Ramaswamy talks taxes, schools and Acton in governor race podcast
stories.summary: Republican gubernatorial nominee Vivek Ramaswamy appeared on the Dispatch Ohio Politics Explained podcast to discuss his race against Democrat Amy Acton ahead of the Nov. 3 election. He pressed his positions on taxes and schools as recent polls show a close contest.
